Classification specifies passed/falsified/mixed and treats undefined or non-finite values and any NULL seed as inconclusive. Behavioral test registration is present, subject to resolving the invalidly confounded control.",
+    "other_scope_checks": "No validation/test behavior, future events, prediction-time user context, or batch-composition signal is declared as training/assignment/target/codebook input. The reconstruction-plus-commitment loss is specified over the nonempty train-item set with coordinate-summed norms and explicit reductions; hard nearest-code assignment and tie-breaking are deterministic. Frozen Stage2 protocol is declared unchanged, with no sweep. Stage2 diagnostic thresholds match the supplied strict frozen thresholds: valid_l1_hard_er >16.38953942232631 and level2_distinct_prefixes >16145; schema_version 1 is represented in the supplied evidence."
